name: enums
sql: SELECT t.typname,e.enumlabel FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_enum e ON e.enumtypid=t.oid WHERE n.nspname=$1 ORDER BY t.typname,e.enumsortorder

name: columns
sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,COALESCE(column_default,''),is_identity,COALESCE(identity_generation,'') FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=$1 AND table_name IN ('artifact_registry_objects','artifact_registry_publications') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

name: constraints
sql: SELECT c.conname,c.contype::text,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true) FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid=c.conrelid WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND r.relname IN ('artifact_registry_objects','artifact_registry_publications') ORDER BY c.conname

name: indexes
sql: SELECT tablename,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname=$1 AND tablename IN ('artifact_registry_objects','artifact_registry_publications') ORDER BY tablename,indexname

name: triggers
sql: SELECT t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY t.tgname

name: functions
sql: SELECT p.proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 ORDER BY p.proname

name: table_privileges
sql: SELECT r.name,c.relname,has_table_privilege(r.name,c.oid,'SELECT'),has_table_privilege(r.name,c.oid,'INSERT'),has_table_privilege(r.name,c.oid,'UPDATE'),has_table_privilege(r.name,c.oid,'DELETE'),has_table_privilege(r.name,c.oid,'TRUNCATE') FROM (VALUES ('artifact_registry_owner'),('artifact_registry_migrator'),('artifact_registry_runtime'),('artifact_registry_maintenance'),('artifact_registry_readiness')) r(name) CROSS JOIN pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relname IN ('artifact_registry_objects','artifact_registry_publications') ORDER BY r.name,c.relname

name: column_select
sql: SELECT r.name,c.relname,a.attname,has_column_privilege(r.name,c.oid,a.attnum,'SELECT') FROM (VALUES ('artifact_registry_migrator'),('artifact_registry_runtime'),('artifact_registry_maintenance'),('artifact_registry_readiness')) r(name) CROSS JOIN pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relname IN ('artifact_registry_objects','artifact_registry_publications') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY r.name,c.relname,a.attnum

name: function_privileges
sql: SELECT r.name,p.proname,has_function_privilege(r.name,p.oid,'EXECUTE') FROM (VALUES ('artifact_registry_owner'),('artifact_registry_migrator'),('artifact_registry_runtime'),('artifact_registry_maintenance'),('artifact_registry_readiness')) r(name) CROSS JOIN pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 ORDER BY r.name,p.proname
